newsitem.title: INDIA: India Marico 96/97 six month net higher.
newsitem.headline: India Marico 96/97 six month net higher.

text.p: Indian processed foods maker Marico Industries said on Wednesday its net profit rose to 112.7 million rupees in the six months to September 30, 1996 from 92.4 million a year ago.
Marico said total profit after tax -- which included "prior period credit" of 12.9 million -- was 125.6 million rupees.
Annualised earnings per share was 15.5 rupees against 12.6 rupees in 1995/96 (April-March), it said in a statement.
"The total revenue generated for the half year ended September 30, 1996 is 1.89 billion rupees, against 1.6 billion in the corresponding period last year," the firm said.
"Volume gains have been recorded by all product groups," it added. Marico said its board declared an interim dividend of 20 percent on enhanced capital.
Depreciation for the first six months of the current year stood at 15.4 million rupees, the firm said.
